ops.title: PR269: preserve Git config and repository-format failures
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali <yasyf@poetic.com>. Next: validate repository-format/config syntax or conservatively decline cases whose semantics are not established. Evidence: internal/gitcmd/discover.go:107, :177; /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/ccn-write-floor-review/pr269-_qireoxt/discovery-results.txt:7 through :9. Format 99, an invalid config escape and bogus GIT_CONFIG_COUNT are accepted by discovery while Git exits 128.

ops.text: Unsupported repository formats, invalid config syntax and invalid injected configuration decline and reproduce Git failures; ordinary maintenance.auto configuration retains the plain fast path.
